subject: AT&T Wants Your Feedback
snippet:
Dear AT&T Customer,
 
 As a valued AT&T customer, your feedback is critical in helping us make
 improvements that result in better solutions, services, and customer
 experiences. Please take a few minutes to share your recent experiences with us.
